name: Arrokoth
tagline: The snowman — two pristine planetesimal lobes fused at the Solar System's edge.

facts.label: Shape
facts.value: Contact binary — flattened lobes joined at a narrow neck

facts.label: Mission
facts.value: New Horizons flyby — January 2019, farthest object visited

history: Arrokoth is the most primitive body ever explored — a cold-classical Kuiper belt object that has sat undisturbed since the Solar System's formation. New Horizons flew past on New Year's Day 2019 and revealed a perfect contact binary: two flattened lobes gently fused at a narrow neck, showing planetesimals assembled from slow-orbiting pebbles rather than violent collisions. Its rust-red surface is methanol ice and organic tholins, essentially the raw material of planetary birth.
